reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $76,515.0 - the exact low of the 05:00Z flush and the floor of this session. This is the honest line now and it replaces the 76,621.4 the endday run used, because the tape has since traded 106.4 points THROUGH that level and bought it back. Spot sits 1,084.2 points above it, which is 1.38 hourly ATRs, so an ordinary hour can reach it without meaning anything - the trigger is a settled CLOSE, not a touch, and the distinction is the whole point this run. Below a settled close there the overnight bid has failed and the next verified shelf is 76,222.2.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull is UP and it is not close: 164,806 USD of shorts were liquidated against 14,591 USD of longs in the same 109 minutes, a ratio of 11.3 to 1, and every short-side cluster sits AT or just above spot between 77,600 and 77,670. Forced short covering is what is carrying price off the 76,515 low. The honest caveat is scale - 179,397 USD in total is a small number for a venue this size, so this is a real directional tell about the last two hours and not evidence of a large standing pool of resting liquidity. The forward heatmap that would show that was not read this run because the free OKX path worked.

etfFlows.note: CORRECTION TO THE ENDDAY REPORT. That run called this a five-day streak on a provisional 21 August total of +68.2m. Farside's table now shows the 21 August row as ALL DASHES with a total of 0.0 - every issuer, not just IBIT - so 21 August has not published and cannot be counted. The verified streak is FOUR consecutive settled inflow days: 17 Aug +297.5m, 18 Aug +189.3m, 19 Aug +517.2m and 20 Aug +606.3m, totalling +1,610.3m. The two days before it were negative (13 Aug -131.1m, 14 Aug -56.2m), so the turn on 17 August is real and the accelerating shape is intact - 20 August alone was the biggest of the four and IBIT took 503.0m of it. Four verified days of genuine spot demand is still the strongest argument that this advance is flow-led rather than a leverage squeeze, and it is the main reason this run adds rather than trims. It is simply one day shorter than yesterday claimed.

calibration.note: Both endday gates are resolved and both are FALSE, and in each case the distinction between a touch and a settled close did the work. The reduce line was a settled 1H close below 76,621.4. The 05:00Z bar traded to 76,515.0, a full 106.4 points THROUGH it - but it closed at 77,390.4, and the lowest settled 1H close of the whole session was that same 77,390.4, some 769.0 points above the line. reduce_fired is false. The add line was a settled 1H close above 78,759.2. The 03:30Z tape printed 78,832.2, 73.0 points THROUGH it - but the best settled 1H close was 78,487.1, some 272.1 points short. add_fired is false. So the endday report drew a range and the market probed both edges inside seven hours and closed inside neither, which is a good sign the levels were placed where the liquidity actually was. On the action: endday trimmed 20 percent of the spot core at 77,972.2 and spot is now 77,599.2, so the trimmed fifth is 373.0 points, or 0.48 percent, better off in cash. Small, but the right sign, and it continues the pattern where this desk's trims into a lower high have paid while the 20 August morning trim into strength did not. acting_helped is true.
